POWER MECHANICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: POWER MECHANICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Monitor
   C. Speaker
   D. Keyboard

2. When learning Braking system, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Braking system.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Braking system.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Braking system.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Braking system.

3. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Ignore burnt cables

4. When learning Suspension system, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Suspension system.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Suspension system.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Suspension system.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Suspension system.

5. When learning Health and safety in a power mechanics work environment, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Health and safety in a power mechanics work environment.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Health and safety in a power mechanics work environment.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Health and safety in a power mechanics work environment.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Health and safety in a power mechanics work environment.

6. When learning Limits, fits and tolerance, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Limits, fits and tolerance.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Limits, fits and tolerance.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Limits, fits and tolerance.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Limits, fits and tolerance.

7. When learning ISO Thread forms, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for ISO Thread forms.
   B. Skip safety briefings for ISO Thread forms.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after ISO Thread forms.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for ISO Thread forms.

8. When learning Project, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Project.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Project.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Project.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project.

9. When learning Isometric projection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Isometric projection.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Isometric projection.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Isometric projection.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Isometric projection.

10. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Internal Cooking Timer

11. When learning Properties and application of Materials in Power mechanics, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Properties and application of Materials in Power mechanics.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Properties and application of Materials in Power mechanics.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Properties and application of Materials in Power mechanics.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Properties and application of Materials in Power mechanics.

12. When learning Principles of Power Mechanics, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Principles of Power Mechanics.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Principles of Power Mechanics.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Principles of Power Mechanics.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Principles of Power Mechanics.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Project and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Isometric projection and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Orthographic projection and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Limits, fits and tolerance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
